title: Drone attacks hit Engels and Dyagilevo airbases in Russia
body:
On 5 December 2022, the Russian Ministry of Defence said Ukraine had attempted strikes on two airbases, Dyagilevo in Ryazan Oblast and Engels in Saratov Oblast. Both bases host strategic bombers. According to a Ministry statement on Telegram, reported by Ukrainska Pravda, the attacks used Soviet-made jet unmanned aerial vehicles that were flying at low altitude and were intercepted by Russian air defences.

The Ministry said that the body covering of two aircraft was slightly damaged by falling drone fragments, and that three technical staff were fatally wounded and four were injured. Russian media separately reported a fuel tanker explosion near Ryazan that killed at least three people, and a drone hitting bombers at an airfield in Saratov Oblast. These were Russian official claims and the report did not independently verify them.

Ukraine did not officially confirm responsibility. A second attack on Engels was reported on 26 December 2022. Russia launched a large missile barrage on Ukraine afterwards.
